w: In the morning, Swamishri blessed the Lt.Governor of New Delhi, Shri Kapoor, at the Akshardham site. Thereafter Swamishri inaugurated the crane by performing puja.
In the evening, the renowned scientist Shri Abdul Kalam arrived at Swamishri's residence. The humble Mr Kalam sought the blessings of Swamishri and an interesting spiritual dialogue followed.

At 11.00 a.m., Swamishri visited the Shri Jagannath Jagdish Mandir in Jamalpur, Amdavad, at the invitation of Mahant Rameshwardasji. It was the eve of the 126 annual rath yatra festival. On Swamishri's arrival, 18 decorated elephants raised their trunks and honored Swamishri. The managing trustee of the mandir garlanded Swamishri and led Swamishri to perform pujan of the three raths (chariots) in which the murtis of Bhagwan Jagannath, Subhadraji and Baldevji would be paraded on the streets of Amdavad. As Swamishri entered the Jagannath Mandir the elephants raised their trunks, trumpeted and offered garland to honor him. Thereafter Swamishri offered pujan to a decorated cow called Ganga and then went to the seat where Mahant Rameshwardasji was seated before a fireplace (dhuni). The Mahant welcomed and honored Swamishri. After applying the holy ash to Thakorji Swamishri applied it on his forehead. Then both the Mahant and Swamishri went to the mandir sanctum for darshan of the murtis of Bhagwan Jagannath, Subhadraji and Baldevji. Swamishri offered pujan to the murtis with garlands, flowers and shawls. Swamishri also offered a bouquet of fruits and sweets for the deities. The Mahant honored Swamishri with a garland, shawl and prasad. Thereafter Swamishri went to the adjacent shrines and performed pujan of the murtis of Shri Narsinh Bhagwan, Tirupatiji, Ranchhodraiji and Dattatrey. In his blessings to the assembly Swamishri said, "It brings me great joy to have done the darshan of the deities on the festival of rath yatra. The murtis were brought from Jagannath and installed here. By having darshan one feels peaceful and he protects all his devotees. Narsinhdasji Maharaj, the former guru, was a great saint. The present Maharaj Pujya Rameshwardasji has spread the glory of Bhagwan Jagannath..." Swamishri performed a pradakshina of the deities and then went for darshan of Shri Hanumanji, Radha Krishna Dev, Laxmiji and Sita Ram installed in the shrine to the right of the main sanctum. After blessing the trustees Swamishri departed.
In the evening assembly balaks, kishores and youths performed the drama ' Brahmanand Darshan', which showed a few incidents from the life of Brahmanand Swami.

Evening Programs Devotees from all over the Southeast region gathered in the Orange County Convention Center in Orlando to offer their respects and devotion to Guruhari Pramukh Swami Maharaj on the celebration of Guru Purnima.

In this special assembly, sadhus sang the glory of Guruhari Pramukh Swami Maharaj through the verse, “Shobho sãdhu gune sadã saral ne…” Sadhus took turns explaining different parts of the verse, describing different virtues Swamishri possesses, including his detachment from the world, simplicity, and vast knowledge. Kishores also presented Swamishri’s qualities through dramas and lively dances. They gave Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Swamishri a grand welcome on a dharmarath into the assembly.

Following this, Swamishri was greeted by the Mayor of Orlando, Buddy Dyer, as well as a Commissioner of Orange County, Homer Hartate. Swamishri blessed the assembly, describing the qualities of a true guru as explained in the Hindu scriptures. At the conclusion of the assembly, all devotees were given a divo to perform arti of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Swamishri.

Swamishri first visited Houston in 1977 and launched satsang. Today the tricennial celebration of Houston Satsang was arranged. The Mayor of Irving City (near Dallas) Mayor Herbert Gears honoured Swamishri and presented a proclamation and Key to the City. Thereafter Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of three hari mandirs: Little Rock (Arkansas), Austin (Texas) and San Antonio. In the afternoon a Women’s Convention was held. The chief guest was Texas State Representative Linda Harper Brown who presented a Resolution to commemorate the BAPS Centenary Year Celebration.

The evening tricennial celebration programme portrayed three decades of Swamishri’s effort in establishing and fostering Satsang. The first decade portrayed Swamishri’s colossal effort through home visits and personal contact. The second decade showed Swamishri’s profound love in fostering Satsang and the final decade reflected the transformations he has inspired. The entire programme was interspersed with speeches and cultural programmes. Krishnaprem Swami and Anandswarup Swami spoke on how Swamishri transforms the lives of people. In conclusion Swamishri blessed the assembly, “By the grace and glory of Bhagwan Swaminarayan we have been blessed with spiritual knowledge. And in his tradition of Gunatit disciples Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj have explained to us the principle of Akshar and Purushottam. Also, they have inspired us with the virtues of dharma, gnan, vairagya and bhakti, and guided us on how to eradicate base nature, addictions and bad habits.”

Keshavkumar, who was on special duty with the CBI, came for darshan. Recently in Kolkata, Naxalites had attacked a train and derailed it, and he had immediately caught those criminals. The government had also recognised his service. In this context Keshavkumar said, "I always have one experience. Whenever there is such a complex investigation, I remember you before beginning the investigation. This time too I remembered you, and within a short while a message came that the men had been caught. In Gujarat too lions were being poached illegally, and the trail led to some areas of Bhavnagar. I had to investigate this very matter. I came out after meeting you, and immediately the news came that these poachers had been caught." He also said, "I will never break my ties with Gujarat."

A fax had come from Haribhai Panchal, president of the well known social organisation 'Sadvichar Parivar'. In it he had made a request, writing, "The rain in Gujarat has been delayed and the crops are in danger of being burnt, so please do something so that prayers and dhun are held in all the Akshar Purushottam mandirs." Of course, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was already having a dhun for rain chanted during his morning puja, but after reading this fax Swamishri immediately acted on it and himself ordered that the dhun be chanted in all the mandirs at the time of the evening arti. In this way Swamishri immediately acts on anyone's good suggestion and wholeheartedly joins in it.

Talk turned to the annakut held at the Sarangpur mandir. In particular, they were talking about what the circumstances were like in the old days. Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Earlier, earthen pans, pots and all such things were brought from the potter's house, and the annakut was offered in them."
We said, "After that, a sweet maker from Barvala used to come and prepare the annakut."
We sadhus tried hard to remember his name, but no one could remember it.
Swamishri immediately said, "Dahyo Kandoi."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was reading letters. Meanwhile Mahendrabhai Joshi phoned from Junagadh. His wife had passed away to Akshardham. His wife had been the coordinator of the women's satsang activities in Junagadh. She had had cancer. In this context Dharmakirti Swami, standing nearby, said, "Even in such a situation Mahendrabhai has kept great strength. He has never held back in the seva of satsang and has never let himself feel sad. When his wife passed away, he did all the rites with a smiling face and scattered gulal (coloured powder). He completed the rites while chanting dhun and bhajans. He is in great strength."
Swamishri gave Mahendrabhai many blessings and showed his pleasure.

The government had also recognised his service. In this context Keshavkumar said, "I have one constant experience. Whenever there is such a complicated investigation, I remember you before starting the investigation. This time too I remembered you, and in a short while a message came that the men had been caught. In Gujarat too, lions were being hunted illegally, and the trail led to some areas of Bhavnagar. I had to investigate in this connection. I met you and came out, and immediately news came that these hunters had been caught." He also said, "I will never break my ties with Gujarat."

In it he had made a request, "The rain has held off in Gujarat and the crops are in danger of burning, so please do something so that prayers and dhun are held in all Akshar-Purushottam mandirs." Of course, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was already having dhun sung for rain in his morning puja, but on reading this fax Swamishri acted on it at once and himself gave the order for dhun to be held in all mandirs at the evening arti. In this way, Swamishri immediately acts on anyone's good suggestion and joins in it wholeheartedly.

There was talk of the annakut held at the Sarangpur mandir. In particular, they were talking about what conditions were like in the old days. Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "In the early days, clay pans and pots were brought from the potter's, and the annakut was offered in them."
We said, "After that a confectioner from Barvala used to come and make the annakut."
We sants tried hard to remember his name, but no one could recall it.
Swamishri immediately said, "Dahyo the confectioner."

ds.t: Strength at a time of loss
w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj was reading letters. Meanwhile, Mahendrabhai Joshi phoned from Junagadh. His wife had passed away to Akshardham. His wife had been the director of the women's satsang activities in Junagadh. She had cancer. In this context Dharmakirti Swami, standing nearby, said, "Even in such a situation, Mahendrabhai has kept great strength. He has never held back from the seva work of satsang and has never let himself be pained. When his wife passed away, he did all the rites with a smiling face and threw gulal (coloured powder). He completed the rites while singing dhun and bhajans. He is full of strength."
Swamishri gave Mahendrabhai many blessings and expressed his pleasure.
During his walk, a reading from Yogi Vani and Swamishri's commentary on it began.
It was read: "Even if he is speaking the truth, do not listen to anyone speaking ill of others."
Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "Speaking the truth means that the person being spoken about really has the fault; even so, do not listen."
Then he said, "These are all clauses, aren't they! If we take hold of one of them, everything else comes with it."
It was read: "...By looking at others' virtues and faults, we fall."
Swamishri said sarcastically, "We feel that by looking at others' virtues and faults, we are moving ahead."
It was read: "...Give hot water to a devotee of Bhagwan and bathe in cold water yourself."
Swamishri smiled and said, "We give it in summer."
It was as if Swamishri had picked out the faults in the milk: he gave voice to our state of mind.
